title: Best Place for the Hub
statement:
A network of `n` stations is a tree with `n - 1` cables. You will put a hub at one station. The cost of the hub is the sum, over all stations, of the number of cables on the path from the hub to that station. Find the smallest possible cost.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. Each of the next `n - 1` lines contains the two stations joined by a cable.

## Output
Print the smallest possible cost.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 15000`
- The cables form a tree.
